letter.subject: Concern about cookie and tracking practices on smiths.com
letter.body:
Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to raise concerns identified during an automated, passive privacy audit of https://smiths.com on 2026-11-08 04:11 UTC. Using a fresh browser session, the audit detected the cookie banner, clicked “Reject non-essential cookies”, then browsed the site and recorded what was still sent.

The pages visited after rejection were:
1. https://www.smiths.com/our-businesses
2. https://www.smiths.com/sustainability-and-impact
3. https://www.smiths.com/news-and-insights

We also reviewed the privacy policy at:
1. https://www.smiths.com/media/zssh42em/applicant-privacy-notice-finnish-2026.pdf

Our concerns are as follows:
1. Our review suggests that Google tracking conflicted with the site’s consent promise. Google requests were recorded both before the banner decision and after the user rejected non-essential cookies. This appears to conflict with the policy statement: “For all other types of cookies we need your permission.”
2. We observed that Google still received data after cookies were rejected. After clicking “Reject non-essential cookies”, 15 requests were made to google-analytics.com and googletagmanager.com.
3. We observed one tracking company that did not appear to be named in the privacy policy reviewed. The policy names 0 companies, and we saw Google. We recognise the policy may describe recipients only by category.

Please would you:
1. Explain each of the points above.
2. Confirm which cookies, trackers or similar technologies you consider strictly necessary or otherwise exempt, and why.
3. Stop any non-essential tracking that is set or triggered without consent.
4. Reply within one month.

If this matter is not resolved, it may be raised with the Information Commissioner’s Office.

Yours faithfully,
Joshua Baker

purposes.label: What the data is used for

lawful_basis.label: The legal basis for using it
lawful_basis.quote: Oikeusperusteemme ovat: toimenpiteiden toteuttaminen pyynnöstäsi ennen työsopimuksen solmimista, lakisääteisten velvoitteiden noudattaminen, oikeutetut etumme tehokkaan ja turvallisen rekrytointiprosessin toteuttamisessa sekä suostumus, kun se on asianmukaista.

recipients.label: Who it is shared with
recipients.quote: Voimme jakaa asiaankuuluvia henkilötietoja valtuutetuille Smithsin työntekijöille ja konserniyhtiöille, rekrytointi- ja teknologiapalvelujen tarjoajien, ammatillisten neuvonantajien, suosittelijoiden, taustatarkistusten suorittajien, sääntelyviranomaisten ja julkisten viranomaisten kanssa.

rights.label: Your rights (access, erasure, objection...)
